name: data-migration-validator
title: Data Migration Validator
description: Pre-execution validation for data migration scripts: idempotence check, data completeness, rollback viability, and edge case handling.
author: SolFoundy

inputs.name: migration_script
inputs.description: Path to migration script or description of migration logic

inputs.name: record_count_source
inputs.description: Expected source record count (0 if unknown)

gates.prompt:
Synthesize validation findings into a migration safety report.

Idempotence: {{idempotence-reviewer}}
Completeness: {{completeness-reviewer}}
Rollback: {{rollback-reviewer}}

Consolidate into executive summary, list critical blockers, required fixes. Assign safety score 1-10. Decision: APPROVE (>=7) / REVISE (4-6) / REJECT (<4).

Return plain text:
## Migration Validation Report
**Safety Score:** [N]/10
**Decision:** APPROVE | REVISE | REJECT
### Summary
### Critical Blockers
### Required Revisions
### Next Steps

loop.exit_condition: synthesizer produced report with APPROVE/REVISE/REJECT decision
